findings.label: Light mode badge mismatch (cv.html)
findings.description: The CV badge is always rendered dark-themed because it's a canvas drawing that doesn't read CSS variables like `--main-color-*`. If cv.html adopts a light mode toggle in the future, the badge won't follow. Current impact is minimal since cv.html's sidebar is already dark, but creates asymmetry with page.html's light mode support.

findings.label: mountLanyard timing assumption
findings.description: The 3D card mounts only after `window.load` event fires and the badge textures are generated. If a user resizes to desktop before the load event completes, the card won't mount until load finishes. The resize handler then catches it on subsequent resizes, so the card appears eventually but not immediately on very first resize to desktop during page load. Edge case but possible on slow networks.
